text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 36 units of plerixafor 24 mg/1.2 mL single-dose vials. Current daily use is 4.3 units, providing 8.4 days on hand as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA’s shortage list records Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC plerixafor injection as To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-03-13 and a note that a business decision was made to discontinue manufacture.

Our position: Existing inventory will be exhausted in approximately one week. No other manufacturer is listed on FDA’s shortage list today. Five alternate suppliers have available product but none disclose the manufacturing plant on their labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place immediate orders with Bryant Ranch Prepack, Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, Gland Pharma Limited, and Novadoz Pharmaceuticals LLC to secure supply; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to request manufacturing site information from each supplier to assess supply-chain risk; requires buyer approval.
3. Pharmacy director to review incoming allocations and set internal distribution limits; requires pharmacy director approval.
4. P&T committee to evaluate therapeutic alternatives and prioritization criteria for current patients; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement while awaiting further FDA updates; relying solely on the discontinued Fresenius Kabi line.
